The company generates substantial revenue ($24.48 billion) and maintains consistent profitability with an 11% operating margin and $1.79 billion in net income. However, its total liabilities are quite high compared to its equity base (leverage of roughly 3.5x), which constrains the rating despite adequate liquidity (current ratio of 1.22). This financial profile—strong market presence and profitability balanced by elevated leverage—is characteristic of a mid-tier investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB
